tab.title: Logs
tab.noHosts: No host has Log Search turned on.

results.startHint: Pick hosts and sources, type what to look for and press Search. Leave the search empty to read recent lines.
results.truncated: Showing the newest {{count}} lines. Narrow the search to see more.

use.title: Use Log Search
use.description: Search logs on hosts you can connect to.

enable.label: Log Search
enable.description: Include this host when searching logs.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Use root or sudo when the login user is not root. Needed to read the whole journal and protected log files.

logPaths.label: Log folders
logPaths.description: Folders to search for log files, separated by commas. Leave empty for /var/log.

showPanel.label: Show the side panel
showPanel.description: Offer the log search panel beside terminals on this host.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the log panel with terminals
companionAutoOpen.description: Open the panel by itself on hosts that have it.

companionSide.label: Panel side
companionSide.description: Where the log panel opens beside a terminal.

companionSize.label: Panel size
companionSize.description: Width or height of the panel in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the edge of the terminal to open the panel.

companion.hint: Search the last hour of logs on this host.
